thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: runtime-pool 'dedicated-gpu-a' pod crashloop detected (>= 6 restarts / 2 nodes flapping). Severity: P1. Paging oncall @oncall-pager :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: acknowleding — I'm on it, joining video briefly. Are customers impacted?
Raj Patel: seeing 503s from inference-api in eu-west-1 for models using runtime v2.3.7. Spike in error-rate to 18%.
Tessa Li: confirming, internal dashboard shows ~120 requests/min failing with container restart reason 'signal 11 (SIGSEGV)'.
Kevin Wu: attaching last lines from kube logs ->
Kevin Wu: ```
2026-03-15T20:12:03Z runtime[pid:1245] ERROR: segfault at 0x7ffef3c1e000 ip 0x7f8b0c1a3f20 sp 0x7ffef3c1dff8
Backtrace (most recent call last):
  runtime::attention_kernel+0x1a0
  runtime::dispatch_fused_kernels+0x2b3
  start_thread+0xf5
  __clone+0x3f
```
Maria Chen: ok that looks like the custom fused attention kernel in the runtime. Any recent rollout?
Raj Patel: rolled out compiled kernels for cuda12 optimizations this morning (v2.3.7). Canary passed earlier but on longer sequences we're seeing mem corruption.
Tessa Li: two nodes (gpu-23, gpu-27) have flapped in last 4 mins, kubelet evicting pods. Looks like OOM+segfault combo.
incident-bot: Note: core dumps enabled on affected nodes. Auto-collect job started (gcore + upload to s3).
Ashley Gomez: quick customer impact: three mid-market customers have ~40% failure rate on embedding endpoints; support tickets coming in. Not full outage but degraded.
Maria Chen: immediate mitigations: 1) cordon gpu-23/gpu-27, 2) drain affected pods to fallback pool (non-optimized runtime), 3) rollback runtime image to v2.3.6 where kernel wasn't patched. Anyone oppose?
Kevin Wu: +1. I'll cordon and taint first.
Kevin Wu: ```bash
kubectl cordon node/gpu-23
kubectl cordon node/gpu-27
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep dedicated-gpu-a | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -n1 kubectl -n inference delete pod
```
Tessa Li: while pods restart I'll push temporary override on Routing to route traffic away from pool 'dedicated-gpu-a' -> 'fallback-gpu' for models using runtime v2.3.7.
Raj Patel: I'm creating a rollback rollout: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:2.3.6 --record` and pausing new canary.
Maria Chen: ops-bot, please increase priority of core uploads and tag them with 'crashwave-2147'.
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Core uploads prioritized, artifacts pushed to s3://redwood-dumps/crashwave-2147/.
Kevin Wu: pods are being recreated on fallback pools, but capacity is limited. Spinning additional nodes now.
Kevin Wu: ```bash
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name asg-gpu-fallback --desired-capacity 6
```
Ashley Gomez: notifying CS about partial impact and suggested mitigation message. Draft: "We're experiencing degraded inference for some models in eu-west-1 due to a runtime kernel regression; we've routed affected traffic to a fallback pool and are rolling back the runtime. Some requests may be delayed."
Maria Chen: nice. Send that now with 'investigating' banner.
Tessa Li: oncall handoff: I'm leaving in 20m. Maria, can you take lead for the next hour?
Maria Chen: taking lead. Raj, can you dig into the canary logs and compare memory patterns between 2.3.6 and 2.3.7?
Raj Patel: on it. Initial diff: allocator patterns show higher peak resident set for 2.3.7 when sequence length > 1024, likely due to prefetch optimization.
Kevin Wu: gdb backtrace from one core (uploaded):
Kevin Wu: ```
#0  0x00007f8b0c1a3f20 in runtime::attention_kernel(cudaStream_t, parameters*)
#1  0x00007f8b0c1b12d4 in runtime::dispatch_fused_kernels(...)
#2  0x000055aa7c2f1c10 in serve_loop+0x210
#3  0x000055aa7c2d3f80 in main
```
Tessa Li: good catch on seq length. Might be an unsafe memcopy introduced in the optimization that assumes aligned buffers. That would explain a SIGSEGV on certain inputs.
Maria Chen: plan: 1) keep rollback to 2.3.6 for now, 2) cordon affected nodes until we hotpatch kernel, 3) collect repro case and failing input, 4) notify affected customers with ETA.
Ashley Gomez: putting targeted CS notes to impacted accounts: estimate 2-3 hours for full remediation if hotpatch needed, else 30-45m for rollback + stabilization.
Raj Patel: I'll create a repro job that runs batch of long sequences against 2.3.7 with ASAN-like malloc hooks to reproduce locally.
incident-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: INC-2147-CRASHWAVE assigned to Maria Chen, Raj Patel, Kevin Wu.
Maria Chen: handing off incident to Raj for root-cause triage — I'll remain on channel for coordination. Raj, take oncall.
Raj Patel: assume lead. I'll post progress updates every 10m.
Kevin Wu: nodes still flapping? gpu-27 shows kernel oom notoom watchdog messages, but post-rollback pods seem stable so far.
Tessa Li: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 3% after routing + rollback. Good signal.
Ashley Gomez: I also asked support to prioritize customers with high SLAs. Getting initial responses calmer. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: reproduced locally with stress harness; segmentation occurs at unaligned pointer in attention kernel. Confirmed regression introduced in commit `a1b2c3` in optimization patch.
Raj Patel: next steps: revert patch in runtime repo, verify with long-sequence tests, publish 2.3.8-hotfix build, then canary to single host before wide rollout.
Maria Chen: go for hotfix, but keep traffic on fallback pool until canary proves stable.
ops-bot: created rollback release ticket: GH-4523 and hotfix branch `hotfix/2147-attn-unaligned`.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: impact reduced. Current severity P2.
Maria Chen: closing note — thanks everyone for fast coordination. Postmortem link will be created once incident is fully stabilized. If you have logs or cores that aren't uploaded, please drop them in the s3 path now.
Raj Patel: will follow up with root-cause writeup and timeline.
Kevin Wu: uncordoning gpu-23/gpu-27 scheduled in 1h once we confirm no latent issues.
Maria Chen: last check: any customer still >10% error? Ashley?
Ashley Gomez: two accounts still at ~12% but CS queued mitigations — likely due to queued retries. Monitoring.
Maria Chen: thanks. I'll set reminder to run retrospective and link tracking ticket. Closing channel for paging, keeping thread for notes. :white_check_mark:
